mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, we are seeing a pleasant 60 degrees with clear conditions at Harriet Park, though it feels a bit brisk at 50 degrees.

The city has announced pavement repairs starting Tuesday, November 10, and Wednesday, November 11. Crews will be milling near Nine Mound Road and Mozart Street on Tuesday, with paving following on Wednesday. Please keep an eye out for no parking signs between 7 AM and 7 PM.

There is a great lineup of local entertainment. Live music is happening at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Looking ahead, yoga is scheduled for tomorrow at Insight Wellness, followed by a busy November 11 featuring trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee.

Turning to our weekly report, on October 21, officers assisted EMS and the fire department at a business on Batker Court for a witnessed cardiac arrest, where the patient was successfully transported to the hospital.

Today's featured flavor at Culver's is the delicious Snickers Swirl. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
